name: Alpen-Caravanpark Tennsee
beschreibung: The **Alpen-Caravanpark Tennsee** campsite is located in **Mittenwald, Tyrol**, in a **high-alpine valley setting** by **Lake Tennsee**. The surrounding **mountain landscape** of the **Karwendel** and **Wetterstein** ranges shapes the atmosphere of the site. The **facilities** include **sanitary buildings**, a **supermarket**, and a **restaurant** with a **roll service**. From the **pitches**, **hiking trails** and **ski areas** of the region are directly accessible. Guests can use the **lake** for **watersports** or take **excursions** to the nearby **mountain peaks**. The campsite serves as a **starting point** for activities in the **Karwendel** and **Wettersteingebirge** ranges.
